first_public_date_basis: The arXiv abstract comments that the work was held until 2026-09-17; an earlier administrative submission date is not treated as public posting.
scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and cites the original base-cusp BSVY lemma; no external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence concerns one-dimensional continuous compactly supported monotone compositions satisfying the displayed local derivative regularity. It neither characterizes arbitrary W1,1/BV nor gives sharp constants.
title: An exact logarithmic-envelope criterion for two endpoint weak oscillation tests
